```text
# #4652: Patch: drop the tautological keywords from the glossary
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Several rows in the keyword glossary (`spec/06-keywords.md`, §6) define a keyword by restating its name. They teach a player nothing and clutter the glossary and its tooltips. This removes them **as keywords** (glossary rows, tooltip entries, aliases and their translations), so the words on a card read as plain text.

**Gameplay stays exactly as it is.** The engine verbs and flags behind these rows (`damage`, `play`, `end_turn`, `set_hand_cap`, `winGame`, `WIN_ON_PLAY_KEY`, `trigger_turn_hooks`, the bottom-of-deck flag, the look-at-a-hand prompt) keep working, and every card that uses them plays the same.

The rows to remove:

| Row | Section | Its rule text today |
|---|---|---|
| Always starts on the bottom of your deck | §6.1 or §6.2 | "Always starts on the bottom of your deck" |
| Win the game | §6.3 | "Win outright by effect" |
| Win on play | §6.3 | "A card that wins its player the game when they play it" |
| Damage | §6.3 | "Deal X damage to a unit or hero" |
| Play | §6.3 | "Pay cost and cast from hand" |
| End the turn | §6.3 | "The turn ends from an effect" |
| Hand size | §6.3 | "A player's hand size for the rest of the game" |
| Trigger End of turn effects | §6.3 | "Run your end-of-turn hooks now" |
| Look at a hand | §6.3 | "See the opponent's hand in a prompt" |

**Keep `Combat keyword`.** It is tautological too, but it names the random keyword pool other rows and rulings rely on, so it stays.

Notes for the builder:
- Several of these rows have engine-semantics text other sections link to (`[[§6.3]] Play` is cited by Cry, Flashback and more; Damage's row holds `halfToHeroes` and the split-damage rule, R1841001). Don't lose that rule text. Move it into the section that owns the mechanic (Play into §10.5, Damage into §4.4, End the turn beside §2.2's end-of-turn steps, and so on), and repoint every link to the removed row, in `spec/` and in code comments.
- Every R-id a removed row cites still has to be cited somewhere `cargo jackioh spec check` can see it.
- `crates/shared/data/glossary.json` has entries for `End the turn`, `Hand size` and `Look at a hand`. Remove those, their aliases and their `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` strings. The web's `rules.test.ts` holds the glossary to §6, so the two must agree. Grep for the others too (they may be under an alias).
- `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md` and `spec/CARDS.md` are written on `main` by `spec-fold.yml`. Don't hand-edit them on the branch (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- This changes no card data. Run `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` before pushing to see whether it needs a fragment.

### Acceptance

- None of the nine rows above is left in `spec/06-keywords.md`. `Combat keyword` is still there.
- `crates/shared/data/glossary.json` has no entry or alias for any of the nine, and `zh-CN.json` has no orphaned string for them.
- The web's `rules.test.ts` (glossary against §6) passes.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` passes, and no `[[§6.3]] <removed row>` link is left in `spec/`.
- The rule text the removed rows carried (beyond the tautological one-liner) is still in the spec, under the section that owns it.
- `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` passes, and `cargo jackioh golden check` and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` show no replay change.

### Blocked by, part of

None.
```
